verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing, metering and entitlements layer built on Stripe, so marketplace payments are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents subscriptions, usage tracking, credit systems, licenses and webhooks, but nothing about onboarding sellers, splitting payments between parties, or paying out to sellers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller
